questions.prompt: What attitude does the second entry encourage?
options: Being playful.
Avoiding every enjoyable activity.
Making every day identical.
Treating obligations as the only valuable part of life.
optionsZh: 把义务当作人生唯一有价值的部分。
analyses: A 2.后面的标题是Be Playful，提出保持玩心。
B 后文提出愉快体验可以有价值。
C 标题未要求每天相同。
D 下文区分义务与玩心，未把义务当唯一价值。

vocabulary.meaning: 有玩心的；以轻松、好奇的态度参与
vocabulary.context: 这里是榜单条目的主题，数字2只是结构标记。
vocabulary.example: A playful attitude can make space for discovery.

questions.prompt: Which examples of obligations are mentioned?
questions.promptZh: 文中举了哪两项日常义务？
options: Only caring for a child and travelling.
Choosing a new job and buying a home.
Doing the dishes and filing taxes.
Reading a novel and attending a concert.
analyses: A 不是本句的列举。
B 本句没有买房和换工作。
C from doing the dishes to filing our taxes明确列举。
D 小说是后面愉快体验的例子，未列音乐会。

vocabulary.meaning: 义务；需要承担或完成的责任
vocabulary.context: 这里以洗碗和报税为日常例子，不等于所有活动都是义务。
vocabulary.example: Daily obligations can include filing taxes.

questions.evidenceQuote: 2. Be Playful! We all have a lot of obligations, from doing the dishes to filing our taxes. When we are so focused on getting things done, many things—especially enjoyable experiences, like reading a novel—appear to be a waste of time.

questions.prompt: What does being 'open to be a fool' suggest in the context?
questions.promptZh: 结合上下文，愿意做个“傻瓜”暗示什么？
options: A demand to disregard every responsibility permanently.
A willingness to play and discover without requiring perfect seriousness.
A claim that learning is impossible during playful moments.
A clinical judgement about the reader's intelligence.
optionsZh: 要求永久无视一切责任。
愿意带着玩心探索，不必事事保持完美严肃。
声称玩耍时不可能学习。
对读者智力的临床判断。
analyses: A 没有永久抛弃所有责任的要求。
B 紧前句把playful moments与发现、学习相连，这是鼓励开放态度。
C may discover和learn something new与之相反。
D 这是引语，不是智力诊断。

vocabulary.meaning: 开放的；愿意接受新体验的
vocabulary.context: 此处表示愿意尝试，而非对智力高低的评价。
vocabulary.example: She remained open to trying something unfamiliar.

questions.evidenceQuote: Yet it is in playful moments and when you are “on vacation from social and economic reality” that we may discover something unexpected, learn something new, and gain new insight into our goals. “Be open to be a fool!”

questions.prompt: What theme introduces the final numbered entry?
questions.promptZh: 最后一条编号条目引入什么主题？
options: Taking action, including on everyday choices.
Avoiding all everyday choices.
Only counting past regrets.
Replacing every personal decision with a survey.
optionsZh: 采取行动，也包括日常选择。
用调查代替每个个人决定。
analyses: A 标题Just Do It及后句small everyday decisions共同给主题。
B 与采取行动及日常选择相反。
C 后悔属于前面的条目。
D 没有将所有决定交给调查。

vocabulary.meaning: 思维方式；看待和处理问题的态度
vocabulary.context: 后句说心理丰富的思维可帮助日常选择，不是保证每次决定正确。
vocabulary.example: A different mindset can help with everyday decisions.

questions.evidenceQuote: 1. Just Do It! Beyond important life decisions, a mindset of psychological richness can help us make small, everyday decisions, too.

questions.prompt: Which everyday choice is posed as an example?
questions.promptZh: 文中提出哪项日常选择作为例子？
options: Move to Boston or return to school.
Go to a baseball game or borrow money.
Visit a new exhibition or stay home.
Choose between two job offers.
optionsZh: 搬到波士顿还是重返学校。
analyses: A 这些是前面关于遗憾的例子。
B 球赛和借钱是其他旅行经历。
C 原句对照new exhibition和stay home。
D 工作机会在不同条目。

vocabulary.meaning: 展览；供人观看作品或物品的活动
vocabulary.context: 这里是一个可选择的日常活动，不是必须参加的指令。
vocabulary.example: She considered visiting a new exhibition.

questions.evidenceQuote: 1. Just Do It! Beyond important life decisions, a mindset of psychological richness can help us make small, everyday decisions, too. Should I go to a new exhibition or stay home?

questions.prompt: What activity is posed as another possible choice?
questions.promptZh: 文中提出的另一个可能选择是什么活动？
options: Taking a cruise to every country.
Going on a hike.
Signing up for a full-time job.
Travelling to Ukraine to find Augustine.
analyses: A 未规定去所有国家。
B Should I go on a hike直接提出徒步。
C 当前问句未提工作。
D 是前面的小说情节。

vocabulary.meaning: 徒步；较长距离的步行活动
vocabulary.context: 这里是作者提出的日常选择示例，不是对读者具体路线的要求。
vocabulary.example: They wondered whether to go on a hike.

questions.evidenceQuote: Should I go on a hike? If you are the type of person who likes to stay within your comfort zone, then I suggest you take a chance and try something new—just do it! On days when people do something new, they feel that the day is psychologically richer, as well as happier and more meaningful. In the poem “Ed,” Louis Simpson introduces his title character Ed as a young man in love with a waitress named Doreen.

questions.prompt: To whom is the suggestion about trying something new addressed?
questions.promptZh: 尝试新事物的建议针对什么人？
options: A person who tends to stay within their comfort zone.
Only a person who already enjoys every possible risk.
Anyone who has never made a decision.
Only the poet's fictional character.
optionsZh: 只有已经喜欢所有风险的人。
analyses: A If you are the type...comfort zone限定建议对象。
B 未要求喜欢全部风险。
C 没有从未决定这一条件。
D 诗歌例子在后面；建议面向倾向熟悉安全的人。

vocabulary.meaning: 舒适区；个人熟悉且相对自在的范围
vocabulary.context: 作者建议尝试新事，不保证所有风险均适合或安全。
vocabulary.example: She tried a small activity outside her comfort zone.

questions.evidenceQuote: Should I go on a hike? If you are the type of person who likes to stay within your comfort zone, then I suggest you take a chance and try something new—just do it! On days when people do something new, they feel that the day is psychologically richer, as well as happier and more meaningful. In the poem “Ed,” Louis Simpson introduces his title character Ed as a young man in love with a waitress named Doreen.

questions.prompt: How is Ed introduced in Louis Simpson's poem?
options: As the author of a study on job satisfaction.
As Doreen's father and a police officer.
As an older man who has never met Doreen.
As a young man in love with a waitress named Doreen.
optionsZh: 工作满意度研究的作者。
一个爱上名叫Doreen的女服务员的年轻人。
analyses: A 他是诗中人物，不是该研究作者。
B 关系和职业均被错配。
C young与in love with不支持这一描述；诗歌是文学叙述。
D young man in love with a waitress named Doreen直接对应。

vocabulary.meaning: 同名主角；与作品标题同名的人物
vocabulary.context: Ed是诗的标题人物，不等于诗人本人。
vocabulary.example: Ed is the title character of the poem.

questions.evidenceQuote: Should I go on a hike? If you are the type of person who likes to stay within your comfort zone, then I suggest you take a chance and try something new—just do it! On days when people do something new, they feel that the day is psychologically richer, as well as happier and more meaningful. In the poem “Ed,” Louis Simpson introduces his title character Ed as a young man in love with a waitress named Doreen.

options: All readers of the book.
The police officers in Washington.
His family and friends.
Only the author of the poem.
analyses: A 不能扩大到所有读者。
B 警察属于不同旅行回忆。
C His family and friends do not approve直接说明群体。
D 句中是家人与朋友，非只说作者。

vocabulary.context: 此处主语是人物的亲友；句子没有测量所有人对此的态度。
vocabulary.example: His family and friends did not approve.

questions.evidenceQuote: His family and friends do not approve. So, instead he marries another woman. Years later, his wife leaves Ed. Ed complains to his friends and family that he should have married Doreen.
